name: Tumblr Coming-of-Age
summary: Tumblr Coming-of-Age (formerly known on this wiki as Cuddle Party ) is a photography and lifestyle aesthetic that was highly popular on Tumblr between roughly 2012 and 2018.
description: Tumblr Coming-of-Age (formerly known on this wiki as Cuddle Party ) is a photography and lifestyle aesthetic that was highly popular on Tumblr between roughly 2012 and 2018. It centers around the "coming of age" experience, capturing the emotional and rebellious spirit of teenagers having fun. It is often considered the teenage equivalent to Indie Sleaze .
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Friendship, youth, teenage rebellion, coming-of-age, nostalgia, angst

visualDNA.Overview: Tumblr Coming-of-Age is generally divided into two main categories: The rebellios side of the aesthetic is closely related to Tumblr's Pale Grunge era, this side focuses on the rebellious teenage spirit. Visuals include pictures of people climbing fences, having house parties, staying out late, and doing mildly rebellious things. A motif is that these actions are almost always done with a group of high school friends, there are rarely ever solo pictures.

fashion.Overview: Fashion within the Tumblr Coming-of-Age aesthetic overlaps heavily with 2010s thrift store culture, Pale Grunge, and Indie Sleaze. It prioritizes comfortable, worn-in, and slightly messy clothing suitable for late-night adventures with friends.

objects: hanging out with high school friends
